title: Weekly digest 2026-W42: 38 items this week
summary: Index of 38 items: Lacia 3, Methode 18, Kouka 4, Saturnus 9, Snowdrop 4.
body:
This week (2026-10-12 to 2026-10-18, Shanghai time) 38 items were published, 38 from the collectors (AUTO) and the rest written by hand. The index follows; each entry opens in its own column.

Kouka (signals): 4 items
- OpenAI 披露与巴西 Itaú 合作，将生成式 AI 推向全部客户群体
  https://openai.com/index/itau-generative-ai
- Google DeepMind 发布 Antigravity 模型，用 AI 大幅加速抗菌肽发现
  https://deepmind.google/blog/accelerating-antimicrobial-discovery
- Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Argon，三篇博客同日上线覆盖主模型、机器人与安全
  https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing-gemini-4-argon
- OpenAI 客户案例：Sophos 借助 ChatGPT 将威胁调查时间缩短 96%
  https://openai.com/index/sophos
Snowdrop (papers): 4 items
- Meta 开源 Muse Spark Open：前沿级多模态 MoE 模型终于开放权重
  https://huggingface.co/blog/meta-muse-spark-open
- Gemini 4 Argon 进入机器人控制：DeepMind 发布物理推理模型，可在 MuJoCo 中练习后操控 Spot 机械狗
  https://developers.googleblog.com/gemini-4-argon-for-robotics
- SWE-Duel：让编码 Agent 红蓝对抗，基准测试自己进化
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12569
- EvoBelief：用可证伪假设让 LLM 智能体自我进化环境信念
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12789
Methode (engineering): 18 items
- llama.cpp b11718：恢复 ESIMD 内核至 FFN 路径，扩展 Q8_0 融合优化
  https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tag/b11718
- vLLM v0.32.0 正式发布，修复 macOS Rust 前端构建问题
  https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/releases/tag/v0.32.0
- Waypoint-OPD：通过门控在线策略蒸馏迁移强化学习诱导的策略迁移
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.24000
- llama.cpp 今晨密集推送 5 个 commit，基础设施侧高度活跃
  https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases
- Athanor：多智能体 autonomous post-training 首次追平官方 instruct 版本
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21055
- Reflection 发布 501B 开源 MoE 模型 Beam，全面开放可定制
  https://huggingface.co/blog/reflection-beam
- ARIA：运行时多智能体系统修复框架，可自动学习"何时干预、如何修正"
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20780
- Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0：全新自动化长程 Agent 评测基准发布
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14146
- 安全警报：RLHF 训练数据引发 AI Agent 权限提升漏洞，CVE-2026-65616 已公开复现
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20437
- ClawLoop：无需外部教师模型，LLM Agent 实现自我改进训练循环
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14118
- Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20588v1
- Tev-27B：长程 Agent 训练新范式，Dense Reward 让开源模型比肩 GPT-6 Astra
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18868v1
Saturnus (audits): 9 items
- Reflection Labs 公开 501B MoE 模型 Beam，Apache 2.0 许可
  https://reflection.ai/blog/beam-is-available
- Meta 发布 Muse Spark Open：816B 多模态开源模型，可在 M5 Ultra Mac Studio 本地运行
  https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-spark-open
- AdFection：数字广告投放零点击间谍软件，2.17亿次响应被污染
  https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/15/israeli-firm-digital-ads-enabling-installation-of-zero-click-spyware-researchers-say
- HN 头条：前沿 AI 实验室被曝漠视安全基础，AI"失控"另有原因
  https://www.csoonline.com/article/4234854/ai-agents-arent-going-rogue-frontier-labs-are-skipping-security-basics.html
- OpenAI 工程师因在高管会议室安装窃听设备被捕
  https://sfstandard.com/2026/10/13/openai-engineer-arrested-alleged-bugging-executive-conference-room
- Character.ai 申请 Chapter 11 破产，迪士尼竞购其资产
  https://blog.character.ai/an-update-on-character-ai
- Anthropic 发布蒸馏攻击防御研究，指名 Zhipu、Moonshot 将美国模型能力注入中国军方系统
  https://www.anthropic.com/research/distillation-defenses
- Meta 发布 Muse Wonder：面向个人 AI Agent 的前沿模型
  https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-wonder
- Zod 4.6.6 疑似被植入恶意代码，供应链安全警报拉响
  https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/commit/d821685ea6732436fcdf786a81d076958471e467
Lacia (digest): 3 items
- DeepSeek发布V4.1-Flash-1017："许愿式编程"让一句话生成完整可玩游戏
  https://www.qbitai.com/2026/10/504067.html
- Anthropic Q3 营收达 168 亿美元：IPO 前夜，蒸馏收入占比曝光
  https://simonwillison.net/2026/oct/15
- Anthropic 公开自研源代码控制系统 Scion：日合并量从 2500 暴涨至 30000 次
  https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/13

lines: This week's digest is ready: 38 items, sorted by column, in your mail.
